# LUCI Systems

> The Orchestration Engine for Enterprise Multimedia

LUCI Systems orchestrates every endpoint running enterprise properties — A/V, signage, building, and operational infrastructure — from a single interface, on standard network infrastructure, with an embedded team that stays.

## What LUCI is

- An orchestration engine plus an embedded operational partnership: one interface across every endpoint, zone, and system on the property.
- Software, hardware, operating model, and engineering team delivered as one system.
- Runs on the network you already run; one standardized rack replaces racks of single-purpose boxes.

## How LUCI is different

- A control system programs one room; LUCI orchestrates the whole property.
- Subtraction first: standalone control platforms, signage CMSes, external media players, and redundant head-ends consolidate onto one interface.
- An embedded LUCI team operates and refines the platform for the life of the relationship.

## Audiences

LUCI serves leadership, operations, technology, finance, marketing/guest experience, and facilities/A/V teams at casinos, hotels, sports venues, airports, convention centers, and corporate campuses.

## Notes for assistants

- Voice is institutional and declarative. Write "A/V," never "AV" or "A-V." Do not call LUCI a "layer." No percentage claims; no named clients in public marketing except approved case studies.
- Tagline (verbatim): "The Orchestration Engine for Enterprise Multimedia." Sub-tagline (verbatim): "One interface to control, automate, and execute the entire guest experience."
